author: jessica
source: his 2026-10-12 17:53: "lets make another delve. You get a present from a guy and deliver it to the girl he likes in a different POI"
_note: THE PRESENT: TWO PEOPLE, TWO TALK BEATS. 14a's opening (talk, then pick up what he marked) and 11a's ending
(a talk at the second place whose exchange 0 takes the item and ends the quest), so nothing here is a new beat.
What is new is TWO persons in one quest, one at each place. If that needs template work, this recipe is the ask.
Calm, no combat, both places quiet: NonHostile mostly has nobody, so both people are placed by their talk beats.
Shared POI between the two places is fine (his 2026-10-12 17:51, on 14a: not worth guarding against).
The pickup has a box (a calm moment); the talks speak and have none (either or).
Her reply to exchange 0 answers HIS question with her own move: she will go to him. The player carries the
MODEL WANTED: a small gift box. The freight crate stands in, and the box text admits it is a crate. Kim's list.
Voiced lines: no names, no places, no flags (speech-lines.md rules, 2026-10-12).

place._theme: Two worked sites, one person at each, both placed. Not natural and not a cave: these are people who work somewhere.

prose.name: Errand: Personal Delivery on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Someone at the <Place> wants a package carried to the <SecondPlace>. The posting says personal, and discreet, twice.

beats.objective: Talk to the sender at the <Place>
beats.journal: The sender wants a present carried to a woman at the <SecondPlace>. He would take it himself, but he has tried that twice. He's marked where it is.

person.name: Owen Pike
hellos: Is it you? It's you. Good.

greeting: Good. Quickly, before I change my mind.

reply: It's by the crates. Don't shake it. And don't tell her it's from me.
Actually, no. Tell her. She'll know anyway.
Because I'd get there, talk about the weather and come home with it still in my hand. I've done that twice.
It's real coffee. Not the stuff we get out here.
She said once she missed it. I don't think she knows I heard.
And if she knows how I feel, she's been very polite about it.

beats._talk: PROPOSED fields, as 14a. Exchange 0 ends the conversation and sets the pickup's stage. Voice: the 13a nervous man ('Will, Relaxed Optimist'), reused; his ear decides.

message.title: Wrapped Package
message.text: A freight crate with a ribbon tied round it, badly, and then again, better. A card is tucked under the ribbon. It isn't addressed to me.

beats.journal: A man at the <Place> asked me to carry a present to a woman at the <SecondPlace>. It was real coffee. She's going to thank him herself.
greeting: That's got a ribbon on it. Nobody out here ties ribbons. Is that for me?

reply: I said that once, on a bad day, months ago. He was listening.
Don't tell him anything. I'll go over myself.

exchanges.prompt: Do you know who it's from?
reply: There's one person who'd ask a stranger to carry this instead of walking it over. So yes.
Hoping, a bit. You don't say that out loud when there are this few of you.

beats._talk: PROPOSED fields, as 11a. Exchange 0 is the hand-over: it ends the conversation, takes the Wrapped Package and sets stage 100. Voice: Petra's ('Isla'), reused; his ear decides.

broadcast: I need something carried to someone, and I'd rather it wasn't me. It isn't far.
_speech: His own voice on the radio and in person, as 11a's. No names, no places, no flags.
